name: Thread Generator
description: Cut a 3D-printable thread into the selected shaft or hole: printed pitches, tolerance classes O.0-O.8 and lower teeth. The thread is an editable feature in the timeline.

size.title: Size
size.description: Auto fits the selected face. Or type a size: M8x1 (diameter x pitch), M10 (diameter, pitch from Pitch), or a UNC size like 1/4-20.

pitch.title: Pitch
pitch.description: Distance from one crest to the next. 1 to 5 mm are the 3D-printed pitches; a larger pitch gives deeper, coarser teeth. ISO standard uses the metric coarse pitch (M8: 1.25 mm). Ignored when Size names a pitch.

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: How much looser this part is on each diameter: O.2 makes a shaft 0.2 mm smaller or a hole 0.2 mm larger. Printing a bolt and a nut? Start with O.2 on both, O.4 if tight, O.15 or O.1 if loose.

height.title: Height
height.description: How far the teeth stick out: 100% is the full ISO height, lower gives flat-topped teeth that are easier to print. Use the same height on the bolt and the nut.

length.title: Length
length.description: Thread length along the face. Empty threads the whole face.
